LibreOffice 26.2 Help

Small Capitals

Changes the selected lowercase characters to uppercase characters, and then reduces their size.

To access this command...

From the menu bar:

Choose Format - Text - Small Capitals.

From toolbars:

Small Capitals

From the keyboard:

CommandCtrl + Shift + K


If the cursor is not in a word, the new text that you enter is written in small capitals.
